subject: Controlling orders of monotonic predictors in multivariate regression

messages.author: 412aa207a5583264
messages.subject: Controlling orders of monotonic predictors in multivariate regression
parts:
I'm working on a multivariate model with monotonic predictors. If I were to code this with brms, my formula would look something like:

brms::bf(cbind(y1, y2) ~ mo(Condition))

As I understand it, that formula implies that the effect of Condition on y1 and y2 will be forced to have the same order (1 < 2 < 3 < 4, for both y1 and y2). Is there a way to control the ordering of the effect of Condition on each of the outcomes separately? That is, would there be a way to specify that the effect of Condition on y1 followed 1 < 2 < 3 < 4, but the effect on y2 followed 1 < 3 < 2 < 4?

Thanks for your time,
Patrick
